build_tapir_models: build TAPIR online model init and predict functions from a checkpoint path for causal tracking
compute_clusters: compute clusters from separation tracks and visibility dicts using recursive splitting and deleting optimization
track_many_points: track random points sampled from videos using TAPIR with query features and causal state
predictions_to_tracks_visibility: extract 2D tracks and visibility scores from TAPIR prediction outputs
preprocess_frames: preprocess uint8 video frames to normalized float32 tensors in [-1, 1] range for model input
